notes: MVPA face/place, k-fold (same-task, split by run) -- for mvpa_workflow.py's model.kfold_cv step. model_conditions.testing/timecourse_decoding are byte-identical to training (same query, no run restriction) by design: model.kfold_cv resolves fold membership -- and the actual train/held-out run split -- entirely from model_conditions.training on its own, so testing/timecourse_decoding just re-list the same eligible rows for their own steps. Because every boldfile testing/timecourse_decoding could ever match is also a training boldfile, mvpa_workflow.py's double-dipping guard (README.md section 6) now skips the held-out test evaluation entirely (no test/ output) and decodes timecourse rows with their own held-out k-fold classifier instead of the full-training one -- see the printed DOUBLE-DIPPING WARNING when you run this. Remove model_conditions.testing if you only want the k-fold (model/) output demonstrated by this example, or restrict testing/timecourse_decoding to genuinely separate runs to see the ungated test/full-training-classifier behavior instead.

pipeline._comment: Only read by slurm/resolve_pipeline_config.sh -- irrelevant to running mvpa_workflow.py/generate_report.py directly (as this example's own README section does). Every path here is a full, already-resolved absolute path -- see README.md section 9.
